scope.population: the fills sampled from 2 re-walked day(s) across 2 coin(s), compared against the mid series named in inputs

declared_not_confirmed.note: settings.py declares these; this run did not state what it used, so they are the declaration and not a property of this artifact

checks.name: gold_standard_forward_return_by_side
checks.assumption: taker_side==1 is a BUY-aggressor (lifts ask); informed buys push the mid UP, so mean forward mid return for side==1 must exceed that for side==0.
checks.method: Re-walked bqm.parse_day for the sample, recovered per-fill entry timestamp (block_time ns//1e6), taker_side, entry_px (same as i4_midmarkout). Joined the SAME mid_series with the SAME no-lookahead as-of joins (entry side='right'-1, horizon side='left') and computed UNSIGNED r_h=(mid(t+h)-mid(t))/mid(t) at 1/10/60s; split mean r_h by taker_side. Independent of the markout formula.

observed.summary: 1s buy=+1.264bps sell=-1.258bps gap=+2.523bps; 10s buy=+1.302bps sell=-1.326bps gap=+2.628bps; 60s buy=+0.950bps sell=-1.556bps gap=+2.506bps

checks.note: buy-side forward return is above sell-side at every horizon -> side==1 behaves as a buy-aggressor.

checks.name: entry_price_vs_mid_by_side
checks.assumption: A buy-aggressor (side==1) crosses up to the ask so entry_px>=mid; a sell-aggressor (side==0) hits the bid so entry_px<=mid.
checks.method: On the same re-walked fills, joined the entry mid snapshot (last-at-or-before) and measured the fraction of side==1 fills with entry_px>=mid and side==0 fills with entry_px<=mid.
checks.note: both directional fractions favour the assumed side (buys at/above mid, sells at/below mid).

checks.name: markout_sign_reproduction
checks.assumption: stored mo*_mid = sign_taker*(mid(t+h)-mid(t))/mid(t)*1e4 with sign_taker=+1 if side==1 else -1; POSITIVE mean = taker profited = maker adverse-selected.
checks.method: Re-derived mo10 on the sample as sign_taker*r_10*1e4 from the UNSIGNED return and the assumed taker_dir, and compared the SIGN of its mean to the SIGN of the stored mo10_mid mean in quickwin_markouts_mid.npz over the same coins.
checks.note: re-derived markout-sign matches the stored mo10_mid sign.

checks.name: l2_levels_orientation_spread_sign
checks.method: Fraction of mid_series snapshots with spread>0 over the sampled coins.
checks.note: spread is positive on ~all snapshots -> bids/asks not swapped.

checks.name: dir_code_vs_taker_side_agreement
checks.assumption: dir_code-implied buy/sell (Open Long/Close Short=buy, Open Short/Close Long=sell) must equal taker_side (1=buy, 0=sell). Independent of the forward-return / entry-price legs because it reads a DIFFERENT raw key.
checks.method: Loaded quickwin_markouts.npz; mapped dir_code to an implied buy/sell (Open Long 0 / Close Short 3 => buy; Open Short 1 / Close Long 2 => sell), excluded dir_code==-1, and compared the implied direction to taker_side row-by-row, pooled and per coin. Asserts agreement_frac == 1.0.
checks.note: dir_code-implied side equals taker_side on every known-dir fill (zero mismatches) across the coins present -> the buy/sell semantics agree across two independent raw keys, ETH included.
